comparison: selected backend minus one group versus selected backend
boundary: supplied routes through complete local MoE output

unsupported.256: No qualified custom target-C64 program; do not extend it here.

g2_coalesced_sparse.name: g2_coalesced_sparse
g2_coalesced_sparse.label: LDS coalesced and sparse G2 output
g2_coalesced_sparse.limitation: Wave coalescing remains in the baseline; this does not price the entire historical scattered-to-coalesced change.

g2_sparse_epilogue.name: g2_sparse_epilogue
g2_sparse_epilogue.label: Skip empty LDS output chunks
g2_sparse_epilogue.limitation: Subset of g2_coalesced_sparse; never sum both deltas as independent PR gains.

paired_load_scheduling.name: paired_load_scheduling
paired_load_scheduling.label: Paired G1/G2 scales and packed input-scale loads
paired_load_scheduling.limitation: Same matrix tiles/split/route grid. Scheduling and scale-load width change together; required ISA waits remain enabled.

small_m_fusion.name: small_m_fusion
small_m_fusion.label: Direct small-row preparation and consumer fusion
small_m_fusion.limitation: One bundle removes inline G1 route/input preparation and G2 local split reduction/packing. The output combination stays BF16 atomic.

small_m_g1_overlap.name: small_m_g1_overlap
small_m_g1_overlap.label: Overlap G1 weight requests with input packing
small_m_g1_overlap.limitation: Subset of small_m_fusion; not an independent additive delta.

small_m_scale_predecode.name: small_m_scale_predecode
small_m_scale_predecode.label: Predecode independent G1 scale operands
small_m_scale_predecode.limitation: Baseline retains required explicit MFMA scale-input NOPs. Subset, not an additive delta.

m8_ballot_merge.name: m8_ballot_merge
m8_ballot_merge.label: Consumer-side eight-row route merge
m8_ballot_merge.limitation: Direct grid72 versus ballot grid65; grouped row layout and compatible output epilogue necessarily change together.

fixed_expert_dispatch.name: fixed_expert_dispatch
fixed_expert_dispatch.label: Fixed expert segments and double-buffered counts
fixed_expert_dispatch.limitation: The chunk-map baseline reuses existing emitters with a new launch adapter and needs fresh GPU qualification. Scratch layout/state reset and route resolution are inseparable.

supplied_direct_combine.name: supplied_direct_combine
supplied_direct_combine.label: Direct BF16 supplied-route accumulation
supplied_direct_combine.limitation: BF16-rounded contributions are unchanged, but ordered FP32 sum becomes BF16 atomic accumulation. Both require explicit own-contract references; exclude from arithmetic-preserving ranking.

reference.intermediate: FP32 SiLU/up before MXFP4 at M1/4/8/32; BF16 storage rounding before MXFP4 at M2/16/64/128
reference.output: BF16 expert operands and direct BF16 atomic sum, except declared ordered baseline
reference.gates: Independent eager/graph references, exact IDs/weights, zero-input clearing, changing-input replay, state and source identity; thresholds unchanged
